reviews.text:
I cannot recommend this company enough.  They have been absolutely wonderful with my dog, Ralph, and have given me so much peace of mind knowing he’s being cared for by people who genuinely love animals.

A special thank you to James, who has been incredible.  Ralph absolutely adores him, and it’s clear how much care, patience and attention he gives every walk.  As a dog mom, that means everything.

The team is reliable, communicative, kind and truly goes above and beyond.  I’m so grateful I found them and will absolutely continue using them whenever I can.  Highly recommend!

We have loved using dogs deserve it and our walker, Logan, in the Roscoe village neighborhood for years. They make scheduling so easy with the app. Great communication with updates about how the walk went including potty breaks, length of time, etc. Our pup knows and loves her walkers and we know she looks forward to her walks each week.

We have been a client of Dogs Deserve It since 2018 and I could not be happier with their service and their love for my dogs.  They treat them like their own :)  the daily walk updates with pictures and cute notes is worth everything!  I love that they assign a walker to your address long term, so you don't have someone new every day and they become part of the family. We've also been fortunate to have walkers that are willing and available for overnight care and stay at our house while we travel :) 5 stars!

Dogs deserve it does an amazing job! I love getting the GPS report card and photos from the dog walk each day. I also love that their walkers are W-2 employees as well which makes me feel confident my dog is in good hands!

I just used DDI for the first time while away on vacation and will definitely be using their services again! Corbin did a great job looking out for my two kittens for check ins.

Update 2 years later: I’m still using DDI regularly for cat check-ins and I can’t recommend them enough! I’ve had several different people and they all do a great job looking out for my two kitties. I also appreciate the company seems to pay their employees well which is probably why there’s less turnover than other places. The prices are very fair and reasonable. Even if you can find somewhere else slightly cheaper, I wouldn’t leave DDI because you can trust their services and people and that’s worth everything when we’re talking about my fur babies!

I have been using Dogs Deserve It for several years now and cannot recommend them enough. I have a used them previously for dog walking, but now that I work from home, I use them for my grumpy old cat when I am away or traveling.  I never have to worry and know that Calvin is in good hands. Logan has been the best with him! I always look forward to the updates and photos they send.

I also love that they provide insurance for their employees.

Best dog walking and pet sitting service we have ever used.  Always a great experience.  The employees of Dog Deserve It treat our pup like their own.  If you are looking for help with your dog look, no further.  We have been clients for 2+ years multiple walks a week and overnights per year.  By far the best company we have ever partnered with!

Dogs Deserve It is by far the best dog walking/pet sitting in Chicago. We have been using them for many years and never once had any issue. They are trustworthy, reliable, and they adore my pets. We use both the dogwalking and the overnight pet sitting where they come to stay at our house for a few days up to a whole week. The best part is they they are so diligent about sending frequent updates and pictures of our girls while we are away which makes leaving them at home A LOT less stressful. We know our girls are in great hands!  Thanks DDI and keep up the great work!

The best dog walkers!
100% Reliable & trustworthy, communicative, and simply great people.

We have been a client of DDI for 15 years. Every dog walker and pet sitter that we have used has been incredible, reliable and sweet with our dogs.  Lauren and her team are always quick to respond to any inquiries and always try to accommodate us and our pets as best as possible.  We highly recommend DDI for your pets!  Special shout out to Logan, Corinne and Angelique for always going above and beyond for our dogs.

We love DDI! We trust them because they are responsive and consistent. The level of communication we receive about each walk is incredible. We also love that the walkers are consistent. Jack has been our dog walker for over 2 years. Our dog loves his DDI walks and looks forward to them each week.
Jack is the best!

Dogs Deserve it has been an extremely trusted, easy to use, and reliable service for walking our dog Ernie! We always know Ernie will be well taken care of and get updates from his walks that make our day. Couldn’t recommend more!
My walker James is amazing!!!

We love dogs to deserve it! Macro, our little Frenchie, can be a handful. But dogs deserve it and their walkers are always accommodating! I love the after walk reports and summaries with pictures and the app makes it very convenient to connect with the walkers and schedule new walks or cancel existing as needed. Kyle and Lauren are both very communicative and always helpful! I would always recommend dogs to deserve it for your walks!

I’ve been using DDI for many years to provide care for my cat while I’m out of town. I love that some of the pet sitters have long standing relationships with my cat and know his personality and habits. Their comments and updates are great, and some of the best photos I have of my pets were taken by DDI staff. It’s clear they love what they do, and I’m able to travel with confidence and not worry about my fur babies at home.

Dogs deserve it is the only dog walking service I’ll use. I always know my dog is well taken care of and even if she doesn’t go potty, or if it’s inclement weather and she won’t go outside, she’s got a friend visiting with her and checking in on her throughout the day! It puts my mind at such ease while I’m at work. The end of walk report is my favorite with photos and updates of my girl, and they even let me know which #s she went, and if the water bowl was refilled! We are so grateful for our dogs deserve it walkers!!! Photos from our walking team included.

We have one happy pup customer. Whether it’s our regular Walker Julia or a sub, our girl Wanda enjoys her daily visit and walk with the Dogs Deserve It Walker. And my wife loves the daily photo she gets.

Management is super responsive if there is anything you need.

DDI was recommended by a friend in the area and we have been SO pleased with them! It takes so much stress off us to know that if our usual walker is unavailable, we are still covered. They’re always on time, transparent and we get the best updates throughout the day with our pup! Our walker, Gift, is an angel and our pup loves seeing her. We’re so grateful for this neighborhood business!
Omg we’ve been using Dogs Deserve It and our dog walker, Gift, is the best ever!  Our dogs are obsessed with her and she is wonderful with them.

Our pup has grown up with Dogs Deserve It, going on 8 years. She absolutely loves every walker she’s had - they are caring, kind, and trustworthy. She quite literally jumps for joy when her current walker, Ellen, arrives or even simply walks by our window on her way to walk another pup. Ellen navigates our dog’s apprehension with other dogs and stubbornness to walk by every restaurant treat bowl with incredible ease. Ellen truly understands and cares for our dog. Ellen was a bright spot making sure our dog felt the love and felt special when a new baby arrived on the scene and she wasn’t getting as much attention.

DDI is responsive, trustworthy and an important part of our life. We owe much of our dog’s training, care and happiness to DDI!
We love DDI!! Charlie and Oakley absolutely adore Jack and Gift!!!

Rachel at Dogs Deserve It has been the best dog walker we could have asked for. Our Cattle dog, Toni, is a tough dog to walk as she is very apprehensive with new people and doesn’t warm up to strangers very easily. Rachel was amazingly patient with her and took the time to build a relationship before taking her on walks. Toni came to love Rachel the same way she does us, which is no easy feat! We know that our dog is in good hands every time she is with Rachel. Rachel even takes the time to avoid other people on walks and gives Toni her space when she needs it. I can’t express how lucky we are to have found Dogs Deserve It and to have found Rachel.

Thank you so much!

We have had the best experience with 2 walkers with Dogs Deserve It: Naomi and Jack! We moved from one neighborhood to another which is why we had to switch but our pup Finnegan has absolutely adored them both! On top of an easy to use app …
